decision.summary: A sustained cross-axis displacement initiates around index 538: N increases by ~4.5 MAD, E decreases by ~2.2 MAD, and U drops sharply (~-18 MAD) over 6–7 samples (538–544). The offset persists through index 567; U shows partial recovery only at index 579 (outside the sustained interior), while N/E remain displaced. No clear opposing return is observed within allowed context [503,579]; thus, the interval is classified as uncertain. The optional jump at index 551 (small N/E shift, large U jump) lies within this sustained offset and does not mark a new event.
